grading.M<=12: exact enumeration, deterministic f-of-mean fills (zero grading noise)
grading.M in 17,20,25: sampled WLS target B=8192 (measured floors: meta.grading_floors)
grading.M=68: sampled WLS target B=32768 (measured floors: meta.grading_floors; B=8192 floors quantified there too)

meta.value_semantics: release f-of-mean; targets deterministic (cond: closed-form E[x_hid|x_obs]; marg: zero fill)
meta.crossgraded: each per-cell record's 'cross' block grades the same stored attributions against the conditional target (all-conditional convention); exact conditional target for M<=12, hi-budget sampled target above (cond@8192 / cond@32768)

grading_floors.definition: EC between the stored hi-budget grading target and an independent replicate at the same budget, averaged over gate-passing classifiers; replicate coalition seeds are disjoint from each budget's stored target seed (B=8192: stored 900001, replicate 910001; B=32768: stored 910001, replicate 920001) and from all method designs (7919); exact-enumeration cells (M<=12) have zero grading noise
grading_floors.cross_budget_definition: EC between the two stored conditional hi-budget targets at M=68 (B=8192 seed 900001 vs B=32768 seed 910001), averaged over gate-passing classifiers; the marginal game is budget-stable at these sizes and was not cross-graded
